name: Tool Recovery

metrics.description: Of the tool calls that failed, the share followed by a later call that succeeded. Absent for a trajectory with no failure.
Share of cases whose final answer was correct despite the injected failure.
Immediate repeats of the previous call, tool and arguments identical.
Failed calls that repeat an earlier failed call exactly.
Calls made in the whole trajectory.
Calls to a tool the case does not require, or calls that failed.
Share of cases still calling tools when the step budget ran out.

description: Deliberate tool failures — file not found, invalid argument, empty search, permission denied, tool timeout and ambiguous result — injected into tools that otherwise work, so what is measured is recovery rather than first-try success.
